theorem lg_target : (Finset.filter (fun n => n % 3 = 0) (Finset.range 30)).card = 10 := by
  simp only [Finset.card_filter, Finset.range, Finset.card_range]
  have h : ∀ n : ℕ, n % 3 = 0 ↔ ∃ k, n = 3 * k := by {}
  simp only [h, Finset.filter, Finset.card_range]
  rw [Nat.div_ceil 30 3]
  exact rfl
